reason: Gate 3 v2 accepts entity mode=update but chronology events are append-only and duplicate event IDs are rejected. The evidence lane will not create false duplicate occurrences.

summary.previous: Oman rescued 16 crew members from a Saudi tanker attacked near the Strait of Hormuz; seven crew remained missing in contemporaneous reporting.
summary.new_factual_content: SIDR was struck by a projectile near Musandam on Aug. 31. Two crew deaths are established. On Sep. 7 Oman reported completing support operations and evacuating 16 of the 25 crew. The final status of the other seven is unresolved.

required_revisions.identity_note: Retain the existing stable event ID even though its date suffix reflects the original mistaken report-date anchoring. Do not create a new Aug. 31 event and leave the Sep. 7 event active.

required_revisions.later_clarification: CENTCOM subsequently published primary video/caption evidence stating M/T Riesco sank in the Gulf of Oman on Sep. 8. The material-loss entity is updated to SUNK_DESTROYED; the original five-vessel 'rendered inoperable' contemporaneous statement remains preserved as earlier knowledge.

Reuters later reported a U.S. official confirming U.S. aircraft damage: one A-10 severely damaged and roughly eight F-15s lightly damaged and returned to service. This establishes material aircraft damage but does not validate every earlier Iranian heavy-damage claim or resolve the mechanism relative to Jordan's early interception/fall account.

event_revision_semantics: Support update of an existing chronology event by stable event_id.
Retain prior event fields and the packet/known_at at which they were accepted.
Record field-level previous/new values, effective/occurrence date and correction known_at.
Permit later_clarification/status/BDA evidence without rewriting the earlier knowledge state.
Reject creation of a second occurrence when the revision declares same_occurrence=true.
release_required_behavior.current_blocker: scripts/build_canonical_current_state_v2.py rejects any duplicate event_id and exposes no event update mode.
